title: M5 exit with the capped leaf: blueprint vs the capped endgame bot (NLHE, full 8-player SNGs)
description: Pre-registered before the final pack existed. A is the strongest Stage 3 bot (base policy with confidence-capped population-response push/fold tables); B is the final main-v3 pack with the same capped tables as its short-stack leaf (artifacts/blueprint/bundles/final-capped, from `make blueprint-bundles`), so the comparison isolates the blueprint above the leaf's range. min_effect 0. One of two co-primary M5 exit tests (blueprint-vs-endgame-points, blueprint-capped-vs-endgame-capped), Holm-corrected at 0.05.
